numerical_recomputation.notes: Expected jitter delay is not a deadline guarantee or fleet peak bound; sequential attempts recompute against current remaining time.

evidence: Verified finite attempts plus one inherited finite deadline gives policy termination when waits/calls obey deadline and cancellation.
Verified deadline-preservation inequality t + delay + meaningful attempt + reserve <= T under declared local timing assumptions.

Verified atomic same-identity/request-fingerprint binding yields conditional replay safety within the authority scope; verified retry owners multiply total leaf attempts as the product of per-layer attempts.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Arguments do not prove scheduler timing, server durability, downstream effect uniqueness, random independence or availability.
